verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine. It runs models on the device (iOS, Android, Windows and macOS apps) and serves them from localhost at 127.0.0.1. That architecture implies user prompts are processed locally rather than sent to a vendor that could train on them. However, the evidence never states this as a privacy guarantee. missing for 10: an explicit no-training or data-use policy, a statement of no telemetry or data collection, any opt-out control, and independent verification that no data leaves the device.
